detail_text: Also, there are no written testing programs designed to assess the stability characteristics of drug products. Specifically, A. Your firm lacked valid analytical and stability data to support the 60, 90, and 18O-day beyond use-date (BUD) expiration date assigned to all of your products such as Vancomycin, Sodium Thiosulfate, and Ephedrine Sulfate. B. While you began to develop stability protocols for some of your product you fail to have stabiJity <Redacted B4> data for batches of products in accordance to the protocols you have written. This failure extends to all of your products as you do not have stability data for a representative number of batches for any of your marketed and distributed products. In addition, you do not have an on-going stability program for your products. C. Your firm has incomplete methods and methods validations for the following products: l. Bevacizumab (Avastin) Injection Solution-no method validation for potency, and no potency testing is performed.
